title: Demonic Blacksmith Ritual
description: A red demonic figure with a glowing blue face and green spiky hair stands at a stone anvil hammering a piece of metal that glows red hot. His hands grip a large hammer and the metal on the anvil while bright red and blue beams of light shine down from a swirling vortex above filled with green and blue marks and runes painted on the picture.
prompt: A red demonic figure with glowing blue face and green spiky hair stands at a stone anvil in the center hammering glowing red hot metal with a large hammer. Bright red and blue beams of light shine down from a swirling vortex in the dark sky above that contains green and blue painted marks. Stone platform with patches of green grass roots hanging over the edges small red demon figure sitting on the ground open book and colored circles on the stone floor dramatic fantasy scene.
